name: qa-mutation-testing
description: Mutation testing across languages: 6 skills (stryker-mutation, stryker-net-mutation, pitest-mutation, mutmut-mutation, mull-mutation, mutant-survival-triage). One canonical tool per language (JS/TS Stryker, .NET Stryker.NET, JVM PIT, Python Mutmut, C/C++ Mull - decision table in the README), plus the survivor-triage workflow that classifies why mutants survived and drafts the killing tests.
